design_basis: One shared puller fan for engine bay, engine radiator/CAC and hydraulic oil cooling. Supersedes LT8 two-fan cooling.

air_path.air_sealing_status: Floor support cutouts, core edges, removable joints and service openings require sealed interfaces and leakage testing; nominal CAD does not establish airtightness.

fan_drive_load: Unselected; pressure/efficiency sensitivities are not committed drivetrain loads.
thermal_supplier_inputs: Configured engine, CAC, hydraulic and surface/exhaust-to-bay heat duties
Core order, actual inlet-temperature capability and pressure curves
Single fan installed duty point, drive power, dimensions and supplier mounts
Frame/support reactions, wet mass, cantilever/vibration and structural approval
Inlet protection, sealed floor penetrations, drainage and screen pressure drop
Discharge turning losses, louver free area and external recirculation
Actual fan removal/handling, core cleaning and service access
Stationary hot-weather full-load verification with all service panels closed
retained_access: LT8 removable rails retained; anchor interfaces, panel handling and hatch stay still open.
